E1.evidence: Issue #698 is filed as a "## Feature request": "The `navsat_transform_node` TF child (or parent) `frame_id` is currently hardcoded -- this could be easily be made parametric; the usecase I have at hand is related to testing the performance of different localization pipelines right up to the UTM frame". No failure, reproducer, or log is reported. PR #699 ("Make the navsat tf frame name parametric", merged to noetic-devel 2021-11-23) adds the parameter. The second linked PR, nobleo/rviz_satellite #105 ("Add UTM frame mode"), adds a new tile-placement mode to an RViz plugin and is also a feature. Additional context: PR #699 merge 8766d77a501cbf58dac0e736b439d7eb30e7fa2f (noetic-devel), changes include/robot_localization/navsat_transform.h and src/navsat_transform.cpp. Later comments on #698 discuss encoding the UTM zone in the frame name ("Or.... add the zone-name to the utm frame-name such as `utm30s` or `utm29n`.") as a design idea, without a reported failure. In rviz_satellite #105 the author motivates the UTM mode by tile misplacement when fix messages are noisy relative to the optimized TF ("This results in large inaccuracies in the tile positioning."); that is a limitation of rviz_satellite's placement method addressed by a new option, not a defect in the composition with navsat_transform_node, and the maintainer notes navsat_transform's filtered GPS output as an existing alternative.

E2.evidence: Not evaluated beyond E1. No failed interaction between two units is described; the request is to make the UTM frame name configurable for multiple TF trees.

ineligible_reason: E1: feature request (configurable UTM frame name in navsat_transform_node); no defect is documented. The rviz_satellite PR is a separate feature (UTM frame mode for tile placement).
